conventions.edge_categories: counts can overlap; actual rounded logs of stored cumulative count; no quotient recomputed
conventions.scope: saved-product tables only; source allocation remains incomplete unless its own terminal records prove otherwise
conventions.shells: 16 sharp 128-site shells; existing strict abs(folded_index)>512; ties excluded
conventions.tiny_positive_denominator: no new floor; relative error unbounded without an input error allowance
conventions.weights: 16k applied once; stored shell counts already include f and 1/4096
conventions.zero_or_negative_denominator: share null, flags retained; no clipping

execution.completion_evidence_required: supervisor execution record and actual outer command exit; worker-only JSON is insufficient
execution.timing_scope: sample starts after supervisor imports/configure and ends before final hash/save; the 1s reserve is nominal, not a proved whole-process completion interval

missing_work_completion.order: all missing joint/FFT and three matched summaries, then only missing spectra
